body: Moved from docs/tasks/P1-instant-play-and-worst-bugs.md on 6 Nov 2026 (the task files hold the definition only; how far a task is lives on the board). **Status 2026-10-22: code done, tests green, walked on the emulator (`../evidence/README.md#walk-2026-10-22`).** `PlaybackEngine`: a load that never ends is given up after 12 s (`loadTimeout`) with one plain notice and the same song waits to be played again; a newer "play this" ends a stuck load at once (latest wins, `_newGeneration`). Not done: the 3 s limit for local files, and the play/pause-control and frame-cost part (UI lane).
